# Underflow

Underflow is a Software Development company. Underflow employs 1 person, founded in 2019.

## About

Underflow is an AI-powered product studio that turns ideas into intelligent, production-grade applications.

We partner with companies as a senior product squad — handling strategy, design, engineering, and scale. From discovery to launch, we ship real products on a disciplined, de-risked cadence with weekly releases and transparent communication.

What we do:

- Product Strategy & MVP Scoping
- Design Systems & UX
- AI-Powered App Engineering (iOS, Android, Web & Cloud)
- Scale, Support & Performance Optimization

We build AI features that work in the real world — private on-device models, smart workflows, adaptive personalization — all with security and privacy at the core.

Our track record speaks for itself: 4.9-rated apps on the App Store and Google Play, built for startups and Fortune 500 companies alike.

# Mr.AutomotiEV®

Mr.AutomotiEV® is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Mr. automotiev is a company that redefining last-mile mobility with a 100% electric fleet. They provide eco-friendly, cost-efficient, and future-ready solutions across India. Their mission is to move goods and people responsibly, with speed and reliability. Mr.AutomotiEV® employs 9 people (-30.8% YoY, -4 people), founded in 2022. Headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, with presence in United States.

## About

Mr.AutomotiEV is a Pan-India electric mobility solutions provider focused on delivering last-mile connectivity across multiple sectors. We specialize in deploying sustainable electric vehicle (EV) fleets tailored for public transport, logistics, e-commerce, retail, and municipal services.

As a trusted partner in India’s clean mobility revolution, Mr.AutomotiEV supports businesses and institutions in transitioning to zero-emission, cost-effective transportation. From vehicle sourcing and deployment to operational support, we offer end-to-end EV solutions designed to optimize performance and reduce environmental impact.

Our nationwide operations are powered by strong collaborations with leading EV OEMs, charging infrastructure providers, fleet operators, and government agencies. Together, we’re building a future-ready ecosystem that meets the needs of modern mobility while advancing India’s sustainability goals.

Whether it’s urban delivery or passenger movement, Mr.AutomotiEV is your strategic partner for electrifying the last mile.
